The comment names a state the code does not use, and the certificate fixtures no longer exercise the solved terminal field anywhere, so the removal of the base arm's non-wall-caused extrema cannot be told from the field substitution on a reading of the docstring alone.

baseline_suite is empty in the reviewed manifest, so the run's declared gate arms are unreadable and a reader comparing base-gate-summary.log (1 failed) with head-gate-summary.log (10 failed) derives nine added failures where the true added set is zero. The after_suite key records only the single-file wall-split arm, not the thirteen-file gate the brief names, and the tests: line names that one file alone.

The base arm's scratch tree carries no conftest.py, so nova's explicit-path markexpr override (conftest.py:36-46) never ran there and the inherited '-m not slow' default deselected fifteen tests: the eight test_wide_wall_record_builds_below_capacity cases plus seven slow cases in test_contour_tree_sparse_build.py and test_escape_level_certificates.py that the head arm ran. field_evaluator defaults to None and the documented behaviour for that default is to assign 0.0 to every wall and boundary vertex, so a caller that omits it receives a silently false wall field rather than a refusal; the one production caller at nova/equilibrium/topology.py:2594 relies on that default. The value is not consumed by the read today, but it replaces one silently wrong wall value with another.
